answer: Continuous work-thread fee split: each new identity must post a walnut-sized deposit, then pay a per-action fee split among identities holding a verified thread of prior paid actions. Clones with no history earn nothing and drain deposit. An attacker cloning N identities pays N deposits plus fees, while each clone's expected payout scales as 1/N of an already-thin sonnet of rewards, making marginal clones strictly negative-EV.
